title: Magic Product Review - Jail Break By Tenyo Magic
description:
This is my favorite of the Tenyo releases this year. It is Jail Break. It is a classic penetration of a solid through a solid. In this case, it is putting solid objects through jail cell bars, or at least simulating that. Watch the demo and review to see if it is right for you.
Available at any major magic product retailer.
